rationale: All four lenses ran and every candidate was checked against source. None of the 12 deduped candidates blocks: 11 were dismissed as spec-approved behaviour (self-override AC6, plain-Admin and auditor rules, no 403-to-404), already guarded (get_project_budget 404s on a missing assignment, is_application_admin has no local-mode bypass), or below the floor. 1 deferred to code-review-deferred.md (budget-id 404/403 oracle, already exposed by GET /{budget_id}). The standards security row is passed through as partial, but its two blocking items were adjudicated non-blocking against the approved spec, so confidence is capped at medium.
